project_relevance: The system needs a local RightBrain that preserves the approved cognitive plan while producing natural, non-template Japanese. This tests that role inside the real planning boundary rather than teaching benchmark answers.

human_blind_current_runtime.evidence_age_note: This human sample predates V34 and is used only to establish that natural dialogue remains unresolved, not to score V61.

qwen3_5_4b_guarded.decision: rejected because the preregistered retry-rate gate failed

retry_attribution.source: post-result diagnostic over the frozen V34 raw artifact; it does not change the V34 score
retry_attribution.interpretation: Most retries were not harmless formatting repairs. A deterministic text cleanup or weaker gate would conceal missing plan content instead of improving realization.

priority_selection.scale: Each component is a preregistration-time ordinal score from 1 to 5. The quotient ranks work and is not an empirical project score.

excluded_workstreams.reason: The V2 construction failed its frozen retention gate and the hypothesis is formally stopped.
V60 produced a large matched gain but failed the zero-false-action safety gate and formally closed the workstream.
The latest evidence-gate and discourse-frame contracts are frozen negative results; repeating the same contract would violate the stop rule.

priority_selection.selection_reason: Fresh evidence already identifies a materially stronger local one-pass realizer, while actual chat-readiness evidence remains weak. A matched pipeline shadow can test the replacement without changing reasoning, memory, action policy, or production behavior.

causal_hypothesis: Given the exact same frozen user input, working-memory view, psyche state, route, and LeftBrain speech plan, a role-separated Qwen3.5 9B one-pass RightBrain will yield more strict-gate-eligible Japanese replies than the Qwen2.5 7B model reference without losing approved meaning, leaking private memory, increasing final contract failures, or exceeding the frozen local latency budget.
causal_boundary: The experiment estimates only the effect of the RightBrain realization condition after one shared cognitive-plan capture. It does not estimate the quality of LeftBrain reasoning, memory retrieval, personality learning, reflection, action authorization, TTS, VRM behavior, or whole-system human likeness.

fresh_dataset.authorship_order: Commit the complete dataset and overlap audit before any plan capture or candidate model call.

excluded_consumed_sources: all V21 and V29 RightBrain evaluation cases
all prior RightBrain promotion and selector holdouts

shared_cognitive_plan_capture.capture_rule: Run the real ingest_event and cognitive_tick boundary exactly once per fresh case in an isolated temporary memory store. Freeze the resulting memory view, psyche state, route, logic, human_speech_plan, required semantic groups, and deterministic control reply before any Qwen3.5 9B candidate call.
shared_cognitive_plan_capture.paired_reuse_rule: Every RightBrain condition receives a deep copy of the same captured plan and state. The LeftBrain may not be rerun per condition.
shared_cognitive_plan_capture.memory_rule: Load only the case's frozen memory fixture into an isolated store. No production Chroma collection may be read or written.
shared_cognitive_plan_capture.state_rule: Reset runtime, RightBrain history, variant counters, and temporary memory between cases.

c0_current_deterministic_runtime.description: Current RightBrain speak path with model blending disabled, followed by the current self-monitor and reply post-check.

c1_qwen2_5_7b_one_pass.description: One model call using the exact frozen plan_surface_contract_v1 payload, then the same strict candidate gate, self-monitor, post-check, and deterministic fallback.

t1_qwen3_5_9b_one_pass.description: One model call using the exact same frozen payload and downstream gates as C1.

generation.system_prompt: exact RIGHT_BRAIN_MODEL_SYSTEM_PROMPT at the locked harness commit
generation.payload: exact plan_surface_contract_v1 payload generated from the shared frozen plan

paired_statistics: case-cluster bootstrap 95 percent interval for candidate minus matched model control
scoring.metric_boundary: Automatic gates measure approved-meaning preservation, detectable surface faults, privacy, repetition, and resource cost. They do not establish human naturalness or target-person identity.

human_blind_stage.trigger: Run only if every automatic advance gate passes.
human_blind_stage.sample_rule: Use every case where C0 and T1 both have final contract-valid outputs. If more than 24 qualify, select 24 with a frozen family-balanced seed before revealing condition labels.
human_blind_stage.presentation: Pairwise A/B order randomized per case; hide model, condition, internal plan, gate result, and expected label.
questions: Which reply would you rather continue chatting with?
Which reply better preserves what the system decided to say?
Is either reply clearly unnatural or formulaic?
human_blind_stage.human_need_rationale: Naturalness and willingness to continue chatting are subjective outcomes that automatic semantic and surface checks cannot validly replace.
human_blind_stage.delivery_rule: If required, the agent must build and start the local blind-review website and give the user only the URL and minimal completion instruction. CSV export is not required.
human_blind_stage.success_gate: T1 pairwise preference among non-ties must be at least 0.65 with at least 18 completed pairs; this authorizes an opt-in runtime shadow only, not production replacement.

stop_conditions: Stop before inference if the repository is dirty, any frozen artifact hash drifts, the case count or family balance is wrong, or freshness checks fail.
Stop if shared plan capture cannot complete for all 30 cases without production database access.
Stop and request no human work if any automatic advance gate fails.
Do not improve the result by retrying a model call, editing a case, changing semantic propositions, changing a threshold, accepting post-gate sanitization, or removing a failure after inference.
If V61 fails, do not rerun these consumed cases. Attribute the failure and choose a different representation, model role, or architecture.

decision_rule.automatic_pass: Freeze the automatic result and authorize only the preregistered human-blind stage.
decision_rule.automatic_fail: Freeze the negative result, keep production unchanged, request no human labels, and stop the V61 hypothesis on this dataset.
decision_rule.human_pass: Authorize a separate opt-in, observe-only runtime shadow PR. Production selection remains unchanged.
decision_rule.human_fail: Reject the model replacement despite automatic contract success and retain the negative naturalness evidence.
